description:
Everything about one place

Full detail for a place id from `search_places`: profile, hours, scores for the categories reviewers mention most (up to 40), up to eight quotable
statements, good-to-know facts, gluten-free identity when known, and the canonical Atly URL to cite.

id.description: A place id from search_places, or an atly.com place link (with or without https://) or its slug. In a REST path, URL-encode a link.

name: get_place

added_at.description: When Atly added the place. Not a freshness date.

score.description: This category's own 0–10 score. Absent when it fails the test score uses (the place is closed, has under 36 reviews, or too few of its reviews mention this category); reviews is still given. Show no score for it then.

data_refreshed_at.description: When Atly last refreshed the place's data from its sources. Absent when unknown.

distance_km.description: From the search center: the coordinates given, or the area's center (the middle of its bounding box when it has one).

gluten_free.description: Present only for places with a gluten-free identity.

hours.description: Weekly opening hours in the place's local time, one entry per opening (a day can have several). close 24:00 means it closes at midnight; close_day is set when it closes after midnight, on that day. In get_place and the first search results; absent when unknown.

hours_updated_at.description: When the opening hours were last updated. Absent when there are no hours or no date. Over a year old (or absent with hours), say they may have changed and suggest checking with the place.

maps_url.description: Google Maps link for the place (directions), from its Google place id. Not an Atly page: cite url for Atly.

open_now.description: Open at the time of the response, by its hours and timezone; false when the place is closed temporarily or for good. Absent when its hours or timezone are unknown. As fresh as the hours: see hours_updated_at.

kind.description: What the statement is about: Specific Food, Specific Drink, Specific Alcohol (a named dish or drink), Food, Drink, Alcohol, Ambiance, Service, Amenity, Event, Establishment Features or Non-Specific Informative. A gluten-safety warning can carry another, such as Personal Experience, Ambiguous or Other.

reasons.description: Short first-person statements from real reviews, most useful first. Quote them.

score.description: Atly score 0–10 — for the requested categories in search, the overall score in get_place — relative to other places in the same country. Absent when unmeasured (too few reviews, closed, or, in search, a requested category that too few of its reviews mention).

url.description: Canonical Atly page. Link it when you cite. Absent when the place has no page yet.

title: Get place details
